summary: Verified mobile hero aspect-ratio fix (4/3) on RESXPECT marketing site. All acceptance criteria pass: container aspect-ratio is exactly '4 / 3' at 320/375/390/430 mobile widths; heights equal viewportWidth × 3/4 (240, 281.25, 292.5, 322.5). Video element rect equals container rect (identical width AND height) => NO pillarbox and NO letterbox. Screenshots confirm both faces (orange + blue) and full RESXPECT wordmark visible edge-to-edge; leftmost/rightmost pixels are actual video content, not container black. Container stable across t=0,4,8,15s at 390px (390 × 292.5 constant). Desktop (1440x900) and tablet (900x1200) unchanged: aspect-ratio 'auto', object-fit 'cover', wrap fills 100vh. hero-content padding-top computed = 20px (matches spec, headline sits close to video). Wordmark data-testid present, centered horizontally over video area. Per instructions, did NOT retest #why overflow.
